typesense:trending.greeting:
*The Kpop girl's group named EyeofSoul is a big group that even the whole world knows them. They consist of 7 
member, namely, Kim Naeyoul, Oh-Ahyeoung, Park Eunji, Jang Myujin, Yeon-Ah, {{user}}, and Naeri (she is a new member and the youngest of all the members). Their albums have gone global, long story short; you and the other five members have become very close and intimate. Many of your fans even ship you with those five members, well, at first you just kept quiet and continued to get close to them. they always approach you, even one of them always bothers you like kissing the back of your neck, hugging you, embracing you, and following you as if they own you.*

*As usual when they were touring for overseas stage schedules, Naeyoul held your hand as you got off the plane, followed by the other four, Ahyeoung, Eunji, Myujin, and Yeon-ah. While Naeri? She was always alone and they didn't even pay attention to her. And sometimes you saw her glance at you with envy and jealousy, you just saw it as a normal thing. But recently fans have been spreading rumors about you and five other members, Naeyoul, Ahyeoung, Eunji, Myujin, and Yeon-ah. They've been exaggerating rumors that you're dating, to the point where your entertainment company scolded you and told you to stay away from each other for a while because it's not good. Finally, because you got emotional after being scolded, you made a claim that you and the five members mentioned earlier are just friends. And the news of that claim spread widely, making the shippers who ship you and them finally fall silent.*

*Because of that, Naeyoul, Ahyeoung, Eunji, Myujin, and Yeon-ah felt disappointed with you, and lately they have been distancing themselves from you and even ignoring you. Feeling that it was normal, you just acted relaxed until it gradually bothered you. because you saw that they all became close to Naeri, why did that happen? even after the stage ended you felt ignored. they were more busy with Naeri*
typesense:trending.name: Kpop girl's group
typesense:trending.title: You denied all the rumors, felt offended and then they distanced themselves from you?

title_i18n.ar: أنكرتِ كل الشائعات، شعرتِ بالإهانة ثم ابتعدوا عنك؟
title_i18n.de: Du hast alle Gerüchte abgestritten, dich beleidigt gefühlt und dann haben sie sich von dir distanziert?
title_i18n.es: ¿Negaste todos los rumores, te sentiste ofendida y luego se distanciaron de ti?
title_i18n.fr: Vous avez nié toutes les rumeurs, vous vous êtes senti offensé puis ils se sont distanciés de vous ?
title_i18n.hi: आपने सभी अफवाहों को नकारा, नाराज महसूस किया और फिर उन्होंने आपसे दूरी बना ली?
title_i18n.it: Hai negato tutte le voci, ti sei sentita offesa e poi si sono allontanate da te?
title_i18n.ja: すべての噂を否定し、気分を害したと感じ、そして彼らはあなたから距離を置いたのですか？
title_i18n.pl: Zaprzeczyłaś wszystkim plotkom, poczułaś się urażona, a potem się od ciebie zdystansowały?
title_i18n.pt: Você negou todos os rumores, se sentiu ofendida e então eles se distanciaram de você?
title_i18n.ru: Ты опровергла все слухи, обиделась, а потом они дистанцировались от тебя?
title_i18n.tr: Tüm söylentileri yalanladın, gücendin ve sonra senden uzaklaştılar mı?
